offer.title: First time here?
offer.body: A short tour (1 minute) shows how to find calmer places and build a plan.

vibes.title: Pick a mood
vibes.body: Beach, temple, rice fields, sunset: choose the mood you want. The calmest places come first.

visitTime.title: When are you going?
visitTime.body: Crowds are worked out for the hour you arrive. Choose now, in 2 hours, tomorrow morning, or any hour today or tomorrow from the same list.

card.title: Crowd figure
card.body: This percentage is a forecast of the crowd when you arrive, not a live count. Tap a card to see the place.

assist.title: Ask MARGI
assist.body: Describe your plan in everyday words and MARGI lines up calmer places and times.

help.title: Need the guide again?
help.body: Press this button any time to replay the tour of the screen you are on.

chart.title: Crowd by the hour
chart.body: The forecast crowd through the day. The green line marks the quietest hours.

alternatives.title: Calmer places with a similar feel
alternatives.body: When this place is busy, MARGI suggests places with a similar mood and fewer people.

etiquette.title: Good to know
etiquette.body: Customs to respect, such as a sarong and sash at temples.

msmes.title: Local businesses nearby
msmes.body: Warung and family businesses close by. Stopping here spreads tourism income.

plan.title: Plan a trip
plan.body: Start a plan from this place. There you can set the departure time and add stops.

depart.title: Set the departure
depart.body: Choose today or tomorrow, then type the time or step it by 15 minutes.

chart.title: Pick the calmest time
chart.body: Each bar is the crowd on arrival if you leave at that time. Tap the lowest bar to leave when it is calmest.

timeline.title: Your route
timeline.body: Arrival time, crowd and travel time for each stop. Use the arrows to reorder or X to remove.

addStop.title: Add a stop
addStop.body: Search a sight, a warung, a campus or a boarding house. If it is missing, mark it on the map.

copilot.title: Change the plan with MARGI
copilot.body: In the Ask MARGI tab, write a request such as "stop for babi guling on the way". The plan changes only when you press Apply on a suggestion card.

calendar.title: Add to your calendar
calendar.body: Download this plan into Google Calendar or your phone calendar so you do not forget it.

save.title: Save the plan
save.body: Save the plan to open it again later from Plans.

starters.title: Start from an example
starters.body: Tap one of the example questions, or write your own.

input.title: Ask anything about places in Bali
input.body: For example a quiet beach for sunset, babi guling near Ubud, or the calmest hour for Tanah Lot.

cards.title: Place cards
cards.body: MARGI answers with place cards. Add a card to a plan to start building the trip.

difference.title: Chat MARGI and Ask MARGI
difference.body: Chat MARGI answers questions about places. Ask MARGI on the plan screen changes the plan you have open.

welcome.title: Welcome to MARGI
welcome.body: MARGI helps you visit Bali's sights when they are quiet. This tour walks you through the steps, starting with where you set off.

gps.title: Start from where you are
gps.body: Use your phone's location so distances and travel times start from you. Your location is not stored.

areas.title: Or pick an area
areas.body: Not in Bali yet, or planning from somewhere else? Tap one of these areas.

search.title: Search another area
search.body: Type an area such as Ubud or Amed if it is not in the list.

help.title: The guide lives here
help.body: Press this button any time to replay the guide for the screen you are on.

grid.title: What mood are you after?
grid.body: Pick one or more moods: beach, temple, waterfall, sunset, food. Or pick none.

scan.title: Scan the places around you
scan.body: MARGI works out the forecast crowd of nearby places and shows the calmest first.
